content.text:
The robot is now close to the red ball and facing it, and I've called rest.

The last camera view before rest showed the ball just ahead of the feet, slightly to the left. It was too near to stay in the top camera's view, so I only saw it with the head tilted down. I didn't measure the distance to it.

The ball wasn't visible at the start, so I walked forward, then turned left toward open floor. The ball showed up in the left-side sweep.

Rest made the robot shift slightly (odometry theta went from -0.354 to -0.511 rad), so it may now face a little to the right of where it was pointing. I didn't check the view after that shift.
